page.overview:
Who is Andrew Surry?

Andrew Surry is a minor fictional character in Skyfall.

Andrew Surry is one of the five undercover agents whose cover was blown by Silva after he shared their identities on a YouTube video. M told to Bill Tanner to get them out but three was executed in another video. The fate of the other two is unknown. He is presumably dead.
